purpose: Regression for mount identity replacement between initial RO remount and post-remount identity check.

result.warning: DeprecationWarning from pytest_asyncio: asyncio.get_event_loop_policy is deprecated and slated for removal in Python 3.16
result.stdout_capture: The exec tool returned one combined output field. Its displayed text is preserved in the adjacent .console-output.txt transcript; byte-exact stdout was not separately captured.

behavior_asserted: The apply-child guard records owned mount ID 501, then receives replacement ID 999 after remount,ro.
Preflight exits with repository mount identity changed during read-only remount before the extracted region reaches bundle_raw/inventory or configuration payload handling.
Cleanup refuses to unmount the changed mount ID and emits S2_REPO_MOUNT_CLEANUP=refused-mount-changed.
